transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I got frightened by some thoughts I’ve been having. Lately I’ve thought, “It would be easier if I just didn’t wake up tomorrow.” I don’t have any plan to hurt myself, but the thoughts scared me enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not waking up tomorrow?
About eight months, I’d say. It started around when my brother’s health and behavior changed so suddenly. Since then, those thoughts have been coming up.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed most of the time since these thoughts started?

Yes. Most days I do feel sad, or maybe heavy is the better word. It’s like there’s a gray film over everything. Even simple things, like making tea or looking out at my garden, don’t feel the same. There’s just this quiet heaviness in me that I can’t seem to think my way out of.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to enjoy watercolor painting, especially playing with color and light. I still set out my paints sometimes, but then I just sit there looking at the paper. The feeling I used to get from it doesn’t really come, and I end up putting everything away.
Do you still experience pleasure when you're doing things that you normally enjoy, even if it's not as often as you used to?

Not really. I mean, I still try sometimes — I’ll get my watercolor things out and sit down with the paper — but I just end up staring at it. The pleasure I used to get from the colors and the light just doesn’t seem to come, so I usually put it all away.
How long have you been feeling this way, with the sadness and loss of interest in activities?
It’s been about eight months now. It really started around the time my brother’s health and behavior changed so suddenly, and I haven’t felt like myself since then.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight since you started feeling this way?
I haven’t really noticed a significant change. My weight seems about the same, at least nothing that’s stood out to me.
Have you experienced periods of depression like this before?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having a stretch quite like this before, at least not that I would’ve described this way.
Are there any activities or things that still bring you joy or pleasure?

Not much, honestly. I still take out my watercolor things sometimes, but I just end up sitting there looking at the blank paper. The feeling I used to get from the colors and the light just… doesn’t really come, so I put everything away.
Have you ever felt this low or sad before this eight-month period?

I don’t think I’ve felt it quite like this before. Most days now it’s like there’s a gray film over everything, even simple things like making tea or looking out at the garden. There’s just this quiet heaviness in me that I can’t seem to reason my way out of.
Have you had another period like this in your life before the past eight months?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had sad times, of course, but I can’t remember another period that felt like this or lasted in this same way.
Have you had any periods of feeling significantly depressed before the past eight months that lasted for at least two weeks?
No, not that I can recall. I’ve had rough patches, but I don’t remember being depressed like this for two weeks or more before these past months.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt depressed like this?
No, I don’t think so. This feels like the only time in my life it’s been this kind of depressed and gone on like this.
Have you had any other periods in your life where you felt as depressed as you do now, before the past eight months?
No, I don’t think I had anything like this before. This has really been going on about eight months, since my brother’s health and behavior changed so suddenly.
Have you experienced more than one episode of depression in your lifetime, not including the past eight months?
No, not that I can think of. Before these past eight months, I don’t remember having another separate time like this.
Have you had any periods of depression before this one that felt similar?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had sad times before, like anyone, but nothing that felt similar to this.
Have you had any other episodes of depression that lasted for at least two weeks before the past eight months?
No, I don’t believe so. I can’t think of any time before these past eight months where I was depressed like this for two weeks or more.
Have you had any other episodes of depression in your life before the past eight months that a doctor or a mental health professional diagnosed or treated?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve never had an earlier period like this that was diagnosed or treated by a doctor or therapist.
Have you had any periods of feeling better, where your depression symptoms significantly improved, at any point during these past eight months?

Not really, no. It’s been going on for about eight months now, since my brother’s health and behavior changed so suddenly. There may be moments that are a little easier, but I wouldn’t say it’s significantly improved.
